items.q: What should you remember about **Local-first > cloud assistants**?
items.a: **Full machine access is the** unlock; ChatGPT can't control your bed temperature or search your whole disk.

items.q: What should you remember about **Surprise via filesystem**?
items.a: **Agent found year-old Sunday audio** logs user forgot; narrative of last year without explicit setup.

items.q: What should you remember about **Bot-to-bot + human rental**?
items.a: **Restaurant bots negotiate; legacy venues** may need a hired human to call or stand in line.

items.q: What should you remember about **Specialist swarm future**?
items.a: **Separate bots for work, personal life, relationships** — society specializes, so should agents.

items.q: What should you remember about **80% app displacement**?
items.a: **Data-management apps (MyFitnessPal, generic** reminders) replaced by agents that track, infer, and nudge naturally.

items.q: What should you remember about **Sensor apps survive**?
items.a: **Hardware-integrated apps (Tesla, oven,** sonar bed) outlast pure CRUD wrappers.

items.q: What should you remember about **Model moat is temporary**?
items.a: **Users adapt to each new** model within a month; open source catches up on a ~1-year lag.

items.q: What should you remember about **Memory silos vs OpenClaw**?
items.a: **Big chat vendors trap** memories; OpenClaw stores user-owned markdown on disk.

items.q: What should you remember about **Public Discord as marketing**?
items.a: **Couldn't explain on Twitter;** live demo + prompt-injection theater drove understanding.

items.q: What should you remember about **soul.md personality layer**?
items.a: **Core values + human-AI interaction** norms; Marty infused install templates; private soul file never cracked.

items.q: What should you remember about **No MCP by design**?
items.a: **Mac Porter CLI wrapper for** on-demand MCP use without restart; "classical MCP crap" scales poorly.

items.q: What should you remember about **Contrarian git workflow**?
items.a: **Multiple full repo checkouts** on main, not worktrees; minimize cognitive overhead.
